newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: New Afghan rulers set beard dealine for employees.
newsitem.headline: New Afghan rulers set beard dealine for employees.

text.p: Afghanistan's new ruling Taleban Islamic movement on Sunday ordered government employees to grow beards within a month and a half or face Islamic punishment.

An announcement broadcast by the official Kabul Radio, monitored in Islamabad, said the order would apply to employees working in all government offices and in the military, and anyone flouting it would face action under Islamic Sharia law.
But the broadcast did not specify what penalties would be imposed.
It said employees would not be allowed to have short beards. But it did not explain how long a beard should be or say whether beards could be trimmed.
Orthodox Moslem scholars say that growing a beard is a must for a Moslem to follow the Sunnah, or tradition of the Prophet Mohammed. But many others say it is not necessary.
